title: Induction and Monitoring of DNA Phase Separation in Living Cells by a Light-Switching Ruthenium Complex.
authors: Wang, Wen-Jin; Mu, Xia; Tan, Cai-Ping; Wang, Yu-Jian; Zhang, Yuebin; Li, Guohui; Mao, Zong-Wan
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钌配合物诱导活细胞DNA相分离并监测其动态，涉及DNA结合与染色质调控，但核心是化学小分子而非TF-DNA特异性互作，且方法以MD模拟为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限，属广义蛋白-DNA互作的可借鉴文献。
abstract: Phase separation of DNA is involved in chromatin packing for the regulation of gene transcription. Visualization and manipulation of DNA phase separation in living cells present great challenges. Herein, we present a Ru(II) complex (Ru1) with high DNA binding affinity and DNA "light-switch" behavior that can induce and monitor DNA phase separation both in vitro and in living cells. Molecular dynamics simulations indicate that the two phen-PPh(3) ligands with positively charged lipophilic triphenylphosphine substituents and flexible long alkyl chains in Ru1 play essential roles in the formation of multivalent binding forces between DNA molecules to induce DNA phase separation. Importantly, the unique environmental sensitive emission property of Ru1 enables direct visualization of the dynamic process of DNA phase separation in living cells by two-photon phosphorescent lifetime imaging. Moreover, Ru1 can change the gene expression pattern by modulating chromatin accessibility as demonstrated by integrating RNA-sequencing and transposase-accessible chromatin with high-throughput sequencing. In all, we present here the first small-molecule-based tracer and modulator of DNA phase separation in living cells and elucidate its impact on the chromatin state and transcriptome.
abstract_zh: DNA的相分离（phase separation）参与染色质包装，从而调控基因转录。在活细胞中可视化和操纵DNA相分离面临巨大挑战。在此，我们提出一种具有高DNA结合亲和力和DNA“光开关”行为的Ru(II)配合物（Ru1），它能在体外和活细胞中诱导并监测DNA相分离。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟表明，Ru1中带有正电荷亲脂性三苯基膦取代基和柔性长烷基链的两个phen-PPh(3)配体，在DNA分子间形成多价结合力以诱导DNA相分离中发挥关键作用。重要的是，Ru1独特的环境敏感发射特性使其能够通过双光子磷光寿命成像直接可视化活细胞中DNA相分离的动态过程。此外，通过整合RNA测序和转座酶可及染色质高通量测序，我们证明Ru1可通过调节染色质可及性改变基因表达模式。总之，我们在此首次提出一种基于小分子的活细胞DNA相分离示踪剂和调节剂，并阐明其对染色质状态和转录组的影响。
